answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, produced by approved TEE hardware such as Intel SGX. The verifier accepts work only when the enclave proves possession of its unique hardware-backed key and a matching measurement. Thus, copying software, a VM, or a mirror cannot clone an identity; creating another valid identity requires purchasing and attesting additional physical silicon, isolating each agent like an island in a zephyr-resistant trust domain.
